Subject: [PATCH] and state for suggesting relevant content

---
 firefox_privacy_notice/en-US.md | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/firefox_privacy_notice/en-US.md b/firefox_privacy_notice/en-US.md
index d90de77b5..14839847e 100644
--- a/firefox_privacy_notice/en-US.md
+++ b/firefox_privacy_notice/en-US.md
@@ -28,7 +28,7 @@ Read the telemetry documentation for [Desktop](https://firefox-source-docs.mozil
  
 Firefox displays content, such as “Snippets” (messages from Mozilla), Add-on Recommendations, Top Sites (websites suggested by Mozilla for first-time Firefox users), and Pocket Recommendations.
 
-* __Location data__: Firefox uses your IP address to suggest relevant content based on your country.
+* __Location data__: Firefox uses your IP address to suggest relevant content based on your country and state.
 
 * __Technical & Interaction data__: Firefox sends us data such as the position, size and placement of content we suggest, as well as basic data about your interactions with Firefox’s suggested content. This includes the number of times suggested content is displayed or clicked.
